callLogs.transcript:
Agent: Hi Tony, this is Antigravity outreach. I saw Stark Industries is deploying a new automation pipeline. Are you interested in reducing hosting overhead by 30%?
Tony Stark: Yes, that sounds interesting. We have some custom clusters. How do you handle integrations?
Agent: We support custom IMAP rules and Supabase integrations out-of-the-box.
Tony Stark: Okay, I would like to schedule a deep-dive demo next Tuesday at 3 PM.
Agent: Perfect! I am generating a Google Meet link for Tuesday at 3 PM and sending it to tony@starkindustries.com.
callLogs.aiSummary: Tony Stark expressed interest in reducing Stark Industries hosting overhead. He scheduled a deep-dive technical demo for next Tuesday at 3:00 PM. Webhook successfully compiled Google Meet invite.
